service_boundary: Represents the international MiniMax Open Platform API, not MiniMax consumer applications, mainland-China endpoints, or MiniMax models hosted by third parties.
regional_controls: The reviewed international documentation does not establish customer-selected processing regions.
retention_controls: Data handling follows the platform terms and API privacy policy; customers should review capability-specific rules for uploaded and generated media.
routing: Customers select MiniMax-operated models across supported modalities.
customization: The reviewed public API focuses on managed capability endpoints rather than customer-supplied model deployment.
strengths: A single direct platform spans several generative media modalities.
Official documentation provides native and compatible integration guidance.
tradeoffs: Media APIs introduce capability-specific storage and rights considerations.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: MiniMax platform documentation, for the MiniMax Open Platform

upstream_disclosure.note: The privacy policy states the operator processes the content: "Services Input & Output: We process your Input (which may include text, voice, or other content) and Output and any other information you provide in connection with your use of the Service, including any Personal Information contained therein." No subprocessor is named.
upstream_disclosure.scope: MiniMax platform privacy policy, for the MiniMax Open Platform

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "Visit API Keys > Create new secret key to get your API Key" and every documented request uses that key.
credential_handling.scope: MiniMax platform quickstart, for the MiniMax Open Platform

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching reference documents the feature and its billing but never states whether a cache is scoped to the account that created it.
cache_isolation.scope: MiniMax prompt-caching reference, for the MiniMax Open Platform

vulnerability_disclosure.note: No security contact or disclosure policy appears on the contact page, in the terms, or in the privacy policy, and no security.txt is served.
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: MiniMax platform contact page, for the MiniMax Open Platform

independent_audit.note: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent attestation is named on the company page or in the platform documentation.
independent_audit.scope: MiniMax company page, for the MiniMax Open Platform
